summary: Executed backend+frontend integration testing for requested MASK Market MVP1 flows on public preview URL. Backend critical flows passed; mobile app loads and tab navigation works; admin web route fails to render.

ui_bugs.issue: Public /admin renders Expo 'Unmatched Route / Page could not be found' instead of admin login/dashboard.

ui_bugs.component: Mobile Expo screens (auth, tabs, forms, actions)
ui_bugs.issue: Interactive elements are missing testID/data-testid attributes, reducing reliable RN/Expo automation coverage.

integration_issues.flow: Admin web app basic render and API connectivity
integration_issues.issue: Cannot validate admin API connectivity through UI because /admin page is not mounted in preview ingress and never reaches login form.

action_items: Fix deployment/routing so /admin serves Next.js admin app instead of Expo router fallback.
Add testID props to critical mobile interactive components for robust regression UI testing.
Remove insecure/hardcoded admin defaults in /app/admin/app/page.tsx and rely fully on env + user entry.
Align frontend/backend env naming with project standard (EXPO_BACKEND_URL vs EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) to avoid config drift.
critical_code_review_comments: Hardcoded fallback backend URL in admin web: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL || 'http://localhost:8001' (env-only rule violation and can silently break prod preview).
Admin page pre-fills sensitive credentials in UI state (email/password defaults), which is unsafe for deployed admin panel.
JWT secret has weak default fallback in backend (JWT_SECRET default string) instead of fail-fast when missing.
Mobile UI lacks required testID attributes on key interactive components, violating RN testability requirement.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* users/listings/transactions/disputes via public API during pytest flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL from frontend/.env (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Backend flow is regression-covered in /app/backend/tests/test_mask_market_flows.py. Admin web UI currently blocked by route mismatch at /admin.
rca_of_issue: Admin web failure RCA: Repro -> open https://privacy-market.preview.emergentagent.com/admin. Observed Expo Router 'Unmatched Route' page, so Next.js admin app is not reachable from this ingress path. Mitigation -> configure ingress/reverse-proxy to route /admin to admin service/build, then rerun admin UI login/API tests.
